s: Din bor veashpa birshut harabbim ubo g' seipim: bor birshut harabbim haomed betok d' tepachim lirshut hayyachid — muttar lemallot mimmennu lirshut hayyachid zo, shehabbor gam ken reshut hayyachid, sheomqo asara verochbo d', venimtza motzi mereshut hayyachid larshut hayyachid derek meqom petur, shehammaqom panuy shebbenehem meqom petur hu, hoil veen berochbo d'. Veap al pi shekkol maqom sheen bo d' al d' shebbirshut harabbim eno meqom petur ella im ken gaboah g' tepachim mehaaretz, abal pachot mishshelosha reshut harabbim hu, lepi sherabbim doresim alayv, abal hepseq zeh shebben habbor lirshut hayyachid en rabbim boqeim bo, lepi sheeno noach tashmish halikato, hoil veen bo rochab d'. Abal im yesh bo rochab d' — reshut harabbim hu, veen memalleim mibbor zeh lirshut hayyachid zo sheetzlo ella im ken yesh labbor chulya gaboah y' tepachim sebibo, sheaz muttar lemallot mimmennu mereshut hayyachid derek challon haggaboah y' tepachim, lepi shehaddeli sheholek birshut harabbim min hachallon al hachulya, hu holek lemala measara, shehu meqom petur. Vehu shello yehe habbor ureshut hayyachid zo bidyuta achat veorek reshut harabbim mapsiq benehem, ella rochab reshut harabbim, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"z. Abal im hachulya enah gaboah asara — asur lemallot apillu mechallon gaboah asara, lepi shehaddeli holek betok asara, shehu avir reshut harabbim. Veap al pi sherosh hashsheni shel hachebel haqqashur baddeli hu beyado — asur, kemo shennitbaer besimman shn"b. Abal bekarmelit muttar beinyan zeh, kemo shennitbaer sham:

Ashpa birshut harabbim gaboah asara urechaba d' — muttar lizroq lah mereshut hayyachid haqqarob lah pachot md' tepachim, o shezzoreq derek challon haggaboah y' tepachim, kemo shennitbaer. Veen lachush shemma yitgalgel mimmenna lirshut harabbim mah shezzaraq lah vibiennu, lepi sheen zoreqim leashpa ella debarim sheen tzerikim lahem kelal:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Beashpa shel rabbim. Abal beshel yachid — asur lizroq lah kelum mereshut hayyachid, lepi shehayyachid asuy lepannot ashpa shello, veyabou lizroq sham kedarkan gam achar shettinnatel haashpa, venimtzeu zoreqim lirshut harabbim (vaapillu bekarmelit asur):
